scope: Separate criminal-life policyv1, fixed reused country seeds900..911. Real in-memory SQLite/store creation+birth acknowledgement only; all later state changes use immutable normal pure-engine commands. Ordinary school and actual country school-end assessment, one negative compulsory-school leave guard (no dropout action exists), healthy routine and real eligible work; no child offences. At most3 actual nonviolent offences one/year after max(18,countryadult,schoolEnd), in fixed shoplift/pickpocket/burglary order, stopping new crime at35; pickpocket requires an actual known available nonrelative adult victim and all actual skill/health gates apply. Even-index countries post actually affordable bail, odd stay on remand; private counsel once only if quoted fee+3months local living reserve is affordable, else public. Always plead not-guilty without inspecting any hidden detection/investigation/trial/appeal roll. Actual planning pauses allow prison work/study/exercise/quiet routine, one actual prison friendship and available parent visit; direct custody job/study/travel guards retain exact state/RNG. Hospital/discharge months cannot earn prison pay/study. Real releases, reemployment, regulated-job current-record blocks, actual work-abroad application offers without moving, one affordable1month holiday and actual record expiry; eligible retirement and natural death/conserved estate. Genuine acquittals, unavailable stages and early death remain explicit. Holiday travel has current custody/pursuit/court gates, not an invented conviction ban. Cold checks use actual automatic-save packCheckpoint/unpackCheckpoint with whole canonical-world equality and frame sizes, not the smaller plain-import decoder limit. No source limits changed. Only birth uses actual SQLite/store; remainder is not full-journeySQLite/native/physical-performance/contraband-seizure/multigeneration/Scenario A/C acceptance, not additional distinct seeds in the existing120 annual-policy total, and not complete Scenario B while compulsory dropout scope is absent.
